messages:
nina: Quick sync 007 - Pegasus asked for a coordinated lab run to compare perf/W across board revisions. Goal: reproduce steady-state tokens/joule and surface any kernel allocator regressions.

kevin (Pegasus): We're available next week. Proposed short matrix and constraints below. We can provide external watt-meter traces and per-board telemetry over websocket. Prefer upload to a locked S3 prefix.

jin: Please paste the matrix, and confirm which model weight format we should use (fp16 vs q4f16). Also need to know whether we should enable GPU boost.

nina: matrix: (condensed)
```
models: redwood-7b, redwood-13b, redwood-33b
seq: 256, 1024, 4096
batch: 1, 2, 16
board_rev: A1, A2
kernel_modes: stock, slab_alloc_fix, q4f16
stability_smoke: run on redwood-13b seq256 batch2 slab_alloc_fix
metrics: p50,p90,p99 latency, tokens_per_joule, sustained_power_w, peak_temp_c
```
We want per-step token counts and KV cache hit rate.

kevin (Pegasus): We'll emit watt.csv with columns: iso_ts, watts, sensor_label. Onboard telemetry includes temp_c and fan_rpm at 5Hz. We'll share kernel dmesg and module list. Note: slab_alloc_fix is a small allocator patch; we request a smoke run first.

leo: Bench infra note: we'll run in isolated tenancy and pin cpus/gpus. I'll prepare a container image and a runner CLI. Example: 
```
bench-run --model redwood-13b --seq 1024 --batch 2 --mode slab_alloc_fix --power s3://pegasus-lock/run42/watt.csv --out s3://pegasus-lock/run42/metrics.json
```
Output includes tokens_per_joule and a small trace of latency samples.

jin: For data handling/legal: legal insists on an addendum: power traces are restricted, only aggregated perf/W can be public. Can Pegasus confirm?

kevin (Pegasus): That's fine. We expect a co-signed results attestation: both orgs sign-off on the final CSV of aggregated numbers. Raw traces remain private to both teams.

nina: Ops plan: 1) smoke (slab_alloc_fix) within 24h of receiving kernel artifacts. 2) full sweep in two maintenance windows (overnight) with automated sanity checks. 3) runbook will auto-flag runs where tokens_per_joule deviates >5% from median.

bench-bot: smoke run scheduled 2025-06-20T03:00Z slot #P-7. Notifications to #eng-runtime and #eng-sre sent.

leo: I'll push the container and a README to the partnership repo. Will include a CSV schema and sample metrics.json.

kevin (Pegasus): I'll upload kernel cmdline, module list, and the board firmware versions to the S3 handshake and DM the presigned puts.

nina: Action items (quick):
- kevin: firmware + kernel artifacts + power schema (due 24h)
- leo: container + runner + README (due 48h)
- jin: draft telemetry NDA addendum + comms blurb (due 36h)
- bench-bot: post-smoke notification and escalate on failure

kevin (Pegasus): will do. We'll also volunteer to do an internal repro on our side and share a short summary before public numbers. Excited to pair on this.

nina: Thanks all. Keep notes here if any anomalies occur so we have a single source of truth. Will update when NDA draft is uploaded. :rocket:
